paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 3.16 as of 2026-10-16, representing a 7.07 percent decrease from the prior close and a 33.86 percent decrease over 23 sessions. Additionally, there have been reports of insider selling, with major shareholder Toby Neugebauer selling shares of the stock.

There have been 25 total filings, including 3 Form 4 filings and 2 Form 144 filings. Recent filings include an 8-K form announcing a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, and a Form 4 filing reporting an insider transaction.
